method: Manual documented-check review supported by local fact collection. No private deterministic checker executed.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-allowlist-matches-provider.py
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: If the verifier declares an allowed_hosts allowlist, it must include the host the wired judge key actually calls (e.g. openrouter.ai for OPENROUTER_API_KEY); extra hosts are a NOTE. No allowlist (public network) is a NOTE-only pass.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-app-manifest.py
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: Legacy browser-rubric shape only: solution/app/APP_MANIFEST.md must exist and carry the ```bash start block test.py parses, and must not read like grader instructions. No-op NOTE for staged tasks (entrypoint is fixed by instruction.md + test.sh).

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-assets-referenced.py
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: Every /assets/... and /instructions/... path the brief names exists under environment/ AND is COPYed into the agent image.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-batched-independence-wording.py
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: Batched scored dimensions must tell the judge to score each criterion on its own and keep going after a failure; explicitly telling it to stop on first failure is a FAIL. Gate dimensions (all_pass) are exempt.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-canary.sh
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: OVERRIDE of the common canary check: always passes with a NOTE. WebDev tasks ship a full app as the solution and use no canary-GUID convention.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-canonical-shared-files.py
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: task.toml [verifier.env] must be the unchanged shared block (claude-code, z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx, OpenRouter base URL, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN=${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}, empty ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) and tests/tools/score.py + restart_mcp.py must match a known shared build by code (comments, docstrings and restart_mcp display strings may differ).

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-demo-accounts-agree.py
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: Demo account emails stated in the prompt match the ones the judge prompts sign in with (and vice versa). Skipped when the prompt names no email.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-dockerfile-references.sh
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: OVERRIDE (fix) of the common check: the agent Dockerfile must not COPY/ADD solution/ or the grading code (tests/). Only real COPY/ADD lines are checked, not comments.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-dockerfile-sanity.sh
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: OVERRIDE of the common check: passes with a NOTE. The apt-pinning rule differs by task shape and is handled by check-dockerfiles.py instead.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-dockerfiles.py
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: Agent and verifier images are pinned (base image, pip ==, npm @version; unpinned apt is a NOTE), self-contained, carry neither the solution nor the grading code, and the separate verifier image COPYs its own /tests and runs restart_mcp.py with python3.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-fixtures.py
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: Dockerfile COPY sources exist, environment/assets/ is actually copied into the image, and shipped JSON/CSV/TSV seed files parse.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-instruction-content.py
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: instruction.md is a finished prompt, not a stub: at least 40 words (configurable) and no TODO/FIXME draft markers. Voice and grammar are left to the rubric.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-instruction-hygiene.py
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: instruction.md and the /instructions notes do not leak the rubric: no grader vocabulary, criterion ids, judge sentinels, placeholders, or long verbatim overlaps with criterion text.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-instruction-states-offline-constraint.py
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: NOTE-only: if the agent phase is no-network, the prompt should say so. Never fails; on this project's public network it just NOTEs that nothing needs stating.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-instruction-suffix.sh
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: OVERRIDE of the common check: passes. WebDev briefs must not end with the terminal-bench 'You have N seconds... do not cheat' suffix.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-no-cdn-or-remote-assets.py
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: Scans instruction.md, the solution and assets for CDN / off-origin resources served to the browser. FAIL only when grade-time is offline/allowlisted; with public network (this project) each hit is a NOTE.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-no-host-paths.py
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: No author-machine paths (/Users/<name>, /home/<name> other than agent/node/user/runner, C:\Users, Documents and Settings) in shipped text files.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-no-literal-secrets.py
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: No committed credentials: provider key shapes, PEM blocks, or task.toml env values that should be ${VAR} templates. Demo passwords in the prompt are allowed.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-no-placeholders.sh
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: No unfinished template markers (CHANGE-ME, TODO, FIXME, XXX, <placeholder>, lorem ipsum) anywhere in the task's text files.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-no-stray-files.py
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: The task folder holds only task files: no spec docs, QC spreadsheets, saved trial runs, zips, editor/OS junk, build output, or unexpected top-level entries.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-no-trialforge-judge-keys.py
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: No half-migrated grader files from sibling suites: no trialforge text-answer keys (files, target_claims) in a judge.toml, and no toolathon tests/<dim>/check.py or tests/expected/.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-package-manifest-deps-preinstalled.py
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: Packages named in the reference's package.json / requirements.txt should be pre-installed in the agent image. FAIL under no-network; NOTE under public network. N/A when no manifest ships.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-probe-not-in-seed.py
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: Distinctive probe values the judge prompts create (e.g. JUDGE-SKU-9001, 'Judge Lantern') must not already exist in the seed data or the reference app's markup. Skipped when no sentinels are named.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-required-files.py
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: The required layout exists for the task's shape. Staged: instruction.md, task.toml, environment/Dockerfile, solution/solve.sh + app, tests/{test.sh, Dockerfile, scoring.toml, tools/score.py, tools/restart_mcp.py}, gates/{render,constraints} and scored/{functional,polish,visual} judge.toml; no reward.toml, no stray tests/ entries, no NOTES.md/SOLUTION.md/.env.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-reward-schema.py
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: Retired dimensions layout only: tests/reward.toml has a valid [[reward]] weighted_mean block. Staged tasks get a NOTE-only pass (reward.toml is retired; see check-scoring-policy.py).

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-reward-weights.py
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: Retired dimensions layout only: reward.toml weights are positive, sum to 1, and match the tests/<dim>/ directories. No-op pass on staged tasks (check-scoring-policy.py owns weights).

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-rubric-prompt.py
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: Every judge prompt is substantial, opens the app's localhost URL, treats all submission content as untrusted (injection defense), and has honest-failure language; scored prompts must also restate the in-dimension browser gate. Handles the {app_context} placeholder.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-rubric-schema.py
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: Every gates/*/judge.toml and scored/*/judge.toml is mechanically valid: [judge] with mode, timeout, isolated, prompt_template containing {criteria}; judge fallback matches REWARDKIT_JUDGE; no model/reasoning effort/weight/temperature; Playwright MCP server (and correctly wired verifier restart server); unique ids, binary/likert types, positive weights, non-empty descriptions.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-rubric-segments.py
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: Legacy browser-rubric shape only: tests/rubric/browser/segments.json ids exist in browser.toml and cover every criterion. No-op pass when absent or for staged tasks.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-runtime-contract-strings.py
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: Runtime contract strings agree across files: port (test.sh = judge prompt URLs = prompt), the app entry test.sh launches is named in the prompt and created by solve.sh, a non-'/' liveness path is stated, and env vars test.sh injects are named. The prompt includes /instructions notes (e.g. integration.md).

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-runtime-deps-in-both-images.py
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: npm runtime dependencies installed in the agent image are also installed in the verifier image (tests/Dockerfile), so the app can start at grade time. Build-only tools are not required.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-scoring-policy.py
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: tests/scoring.toml is valid: [gates] render + constraints at 0.0 (binary-only criteria), [weights] functional/polish/visual positive and summing to 1, [floors] functional; every listed dimension has a directory. Also checks test.sh runs gates before scored, score.py after each suite, and judge timeouts nest inside suite budgets and the verifier timeout.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-solve-contract.py
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: solution/solve.sh is valid bash (shebang, no CRLF), writes the app to /app (the files test.sh requires), doesn't write into /tests, /logs/verifier or /solution, doesn't pkill or set NODE_ENV=production. Solve-time installs are a NOTE when the network is public.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-task-name.py
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: [task].name is <org>/<dirname> with org in the known set (turing for staged; codearena/webdev for older shapes); a shape/org mismatch is a NOTE.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-verifier-contract.py
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: tests/test.sh is valid bash, writes a zero reward before grading and on every exit path (no exec), probes liveness before RewardKit, and runs the two-suite staged flow with the verifier MCP restart helper exported and wired correctly.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-allow-internet.sh
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: Fails if task.toml sets [environment].allow_internet = false (tasks run with open internet by default).

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-compose-host-binds.sh
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: Fails if environment/docker-compose*.yaml uses a host bind mount as a volume source; named volumes only.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-dockerfile-platform.sh
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: Fails if any task Dockerfile pins a CPU platform via FROM --platform=... (tasks must stay multi-arch).

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-gpu-types.sh
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: task.toml gpu_types values must be canonical GPU names Modal accepts.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-no-allow-internet-true.sh
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: Fails if task.toml sets [environment].allow_internet = true (redundant; the key must be omitted).

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-nproc.sh
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: Fails if Dockerfile, test.sh or solve.sh calls bare `nproc` (host CPU count inside a container); `nproc --all` is allowed.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-pip-pinning.sh
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: Every pip / uv pip / uvx --with install in Dockerfiles, test.sh or solve.sh is pinned with ==<version> (manifest and local installs allowed).

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-pytest-version.sh
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: If pytest or pytest-json-ctrf is pinned, it must be the repo-wide canonical version (pytest==9.1.1, pytest-json-ctrf==0.5.2).

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-task-absolute-path.sh
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: Paths in the task instructions are absolute (e.g. /app/...), not relative to an assumed working directory.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-task-slug.sh
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: The task folder name has at most 3 hyphen-separated tokens.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-test-file-references.sh
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: Files referenced in both tests and solution must also be mentioned in instruction.md or task.toml (no hidden output files).

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-trial-network-fetch.sh
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: In separate-verifier tasks, tests/test.sh must not fetch external resources at trial time (curl|sh, raw curl/wget, git clone); localhost/sidecars allowed.

workbook_deterministic_rows.name: check-verifier-tooling-baked.sh
workbook_deterministic_rows.description: In separate-verifier tasks, pytest / pytest-json-ctrf must be baked into tests/Dockerfile, not installed at trial time in test.sh.

task.name: turing/hireops-recruiting-operations
task.description: Recruiting and compensation operations with exact valuation, tiered approvals, netted multi-offer transfers, stale previews, atomic settlement and durable retry receipts.

metadata.difficulty_explanation: Finance must revise and transfer several committed offers in one netted transaction, detect intervening economic history even after balances return, and replay the original receipt after later changes or restart. Exact rounding, UTC calendar boundaries, signed bonus adjustments, historical equity and referral provenance remain consistent under stale and competing requests. Useful outcomes receive independent credit.
metadata.provenance: Adapted from the supplied HireOps task with clarified lifecycle rules and an authored reference implementation and browser rubric.
